Hi Camila,

Thanks again for the renewal conversation last week. We want to accelerate adoption internally and plan to onboard three additional squads over the next quarter: Search, Support (chatbot), and Billing reconciliation. Current usage sits on our renewal contract (renewal due end of June), and we need a clear plan for:

- API key provisioning/naming per team and per app
- Quotas and predictable throughput (per-squad limits)
- Any isolation or data separation needed for Billing team
- Estimated delta in monthly spend if we add these squads (ballpark is fine)
- Timeline for a pilot (we prefer a short pilot before full rollout)

Can you put together a proposal and a quick rollout playbook? We also want procurement included for PO timing (cc'd).

Hi Elena — great to hear the momentum. I've put a short draft estimate and a recommended rollout approach together (attached: Skyline-Expansion-Estimate-v1.pdf). High level:

- Pilot: 1 squad (Support chatbot) for a 1–2 week pilot to validate latency & cost under representative queries.
- Keys: one key per squad + one shared admin key; we recommend per-app prefixes (skyline-search-, skyline-support-, skyline-billing-) to make quota reporting straightforward.
- Quotas: suggest conservative per-squad token caps initially; we can auto-adjust after pilot.
- Isolation: Billing team can be placed on a dedicated project with stricter retention and KMS controls (we can scope this in the addendum).
- Pricing: incremental uplift tiers included in the PDF; we can provide a multi-squad discount if they commit to >3 teams on renewal.

Next steps I propose:
1) Scoping call with engineering (Ben) and your product lead to align on traffic patterns and pilot goals.
2) Pilot kickoff for Support squad next week (if you greenlight).
3) Procurement & legal: I’ll share a short addendum for the term changes and capacity commit.

Please confirm preferred times for a 30-min call. I’ve also linked the HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/4521) for reference.

Cheers,

Elena / Camila — quick technical notes to surface before the call:

- Key provisioning: we will create distinct API keys per squad and tag them with \"project\" and \"team\" metadata. Recommend: skyline-support, skyline-search, skyline-billing. We can also add environment suffixes if you want (prod/qa).
- Quotas: default soft limits per key; enforced hard limits if desired. For predictable throughput we recommend starting with hosted capacity and moving Billing to a dedicated pool if SLA must be stricter.
- Pilot scope: 1 week focused on peak-hour latency + cost per 1k requests. We will enable detailed token-level logging for the pilot only (retention 90 days) unless you request longer.
- Caching: Support chatbot will benefit most from KV/prefix caching; we can configure prefix caches per key to reduce spend.
- Security: for Billing team we will enable restricted data retention and KMS integration (we'll need your KMS endpoint details).

I'll attach the redwood SAQ response for legal (SAQ-response.xlsx) and can be on the pilot call to walk through expected telemetry.

Ben
